title: Jina AI Releases jina-ocr-v1: A 3.4B MoE Document Parser With Built-In Speculative Decoding for Low-Budget GPUs
description: Jina AI has released jina-ocr-v1, a visual document parser that converts PDFs, scans, tables, charts and invoices into Markdown. The model has 3.4B total parameters, with about 570M active per token, and builds on DeepSeek-OCR. A built-in FastMTP speculative decoding head drafts 3 tokens per step while keeping output lossless.
